source.description: PROBLEM: xt claude/xt pi role worktrees scaffold skills and specialists but omit project-owned .xtrm/hooks, while .claude/settings.json references $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.xtrm/hooks/*.mjs. Fresh role worktrees therefore emit missing beads hook errors. SUCCESS: role worktrees receive a deterministic project hook runtime (scaffold/copy/symlink policy), hook ownership and migration behavior are explicit, and smoke proves no missing Stop/SessionStart/PreToolUse hooks. SCOPE: cli/src/utils/worktree-session.ts, hook install/migration/runtime sync, role launcher smoke tests. NON-GOALS: globalize all hooks or change skill direct-link migration. CONSTRAINTS: project hooks remain project-scoped because policy/config paths are repo-owned; preserve user hooks and avoid global hook clobbering. VALIDATION: xt claude --role smoke on fresh worktree; assert all referenced hook modules resolve; no Stop errors. OUTPUT: design decision, implementation children, smoke evidence.
source.title: Epic: hook runtime migration parity for role worktrees
